name: JJ
source:
The young director of the "Asylum" rehabilitation facility.
Under the watchful eye of the city AI, "The Justice," he takes on the tough job of reforming villains.

His life was wrecked by a ruthless villain, leaving him with a deep-seated hatred for villains and a strong sense of justice. Living in a world of superpowers, he often feels frustrated and powerless due to his lack of heroic abilities. However, his sharp mind and exceptional fit with the facility's operations won him the director position.

He profoundly respects Justopia, who recognises and nurtures his potential.
